about: Pose prompts for Morwen, the rival army's sorceress. Every pose takes her standing image (art/source/morwen-stand.jpg) as its one reference. A staff attacks with a cast: ready, wind-up, slash (the cast), follow-through, recover. The orb stays plain: the magic is drawn in code.
base: The exact same character as the reference: same pale face with a cruel smile, long dark purple hair, a black crown-like headpiece, black and crimson robes with sharp high shoulders and a tattered hem, a long black cape, a dark twisted staff topped with a dark red orb. The orb is dark and not glowing, same colours, same art style, same size in frame. Three-quarter side view facing right. Pose: {pose}. She holds exactly one staff: no second staff, no afterimage, no ghost or blurred copies. A single sharp still frame: no motion blur, no speed lines, no smear, no sparks or effects. Whole figure in frame with margin around it, staff included, even studio lighting, no cast shadow. Plain flat pure green background (#00FF00), no green on the character, no text, no ground.

ready.pose: gathering power: knees slightly bent, the staff held upright in front of her in both hands, eyes narrowed, hair and robes stirring

wind-up.pose: drawing the staff back over her right shoulder with the orb end raised high behind her, her left hand thrust forward with long fingers spread, robes swirling

slash.pose: casting: stepping forward and thrusting the staff straight ahead at arm's length, the orb pointing at the target, her left hand pulled back, robes and hair swept back

follow-through.pose: just after the cast: leaning forward, the staff still extended forward and tipped slightly down, sleeves swinging forward

recover.pose: drawing the staff back toward her body and straightening up, a cruel smile returning

run.pose: running to the right mid-stride, one foot off the ground, the staff held upright at her side in her right hand, robes and hair trailing behind

run-2.pose: running to the right in the passing position: one leg swinging past the other, both feet close to the ground, the staff held upright at her side in her right hand, robes and hair trailing behind

hurt.pose: recoiling backward from a hit, head turned away, teeth gritted in pain, one arm raised, the staff lowered in the other hand, staggering

fallen.pose: fallen to one knee, slumped forward with her head down, defeated, the staff lying on the ground beside her

victory.pose: standing tall in triumph, the staff raised high above her head, her other hand spread before her, laughing cruelly; drawn smaller in the frame so that everything fits, from the top of the staff down to her boots, with empty space below her feet
